<script type="text/javascript">
	$("#cep").mask('00000-000');

	function valcep()
	{
		var cep = document.getElementById('cep').value;

		if (cep.length < 8) 
		{
			document.getElementById('cep').value = '';
			document.getElementById('cep').style.border = '1px solid #FF0000'
			document.getElementById('ceperror').style.display = 'block';
			return false;
		}else
		{
			document.getElementById('cep').style.border = '1px solid #ccc';
			document.getElementById('resultadocep').style.display = 'block';
			document.getElementById('ceperror').style.display = 'none';
		}
	}
</script>
